$comment: IC workspace (dogfood): block cross-repo edits/commits to the toolkit PRIMARY checkout. This workspace stays writable on master; only the linked toolkit checkout is guarded. Commands carry an inline existence check: in a MULTI-ROOT Cursor session ${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR} resolves to ONE root, which may be a repo that has no .cursor/hooks/ of its own — /bin/sh then exits 127 (script not found) and failClosed turns that into a DENY, blocking every edit and shell call across the whole session. A missing script means 'this root is not guard-configured', which is not a policy decision, so it exits 0. The check is inline because a helper script would sit at the same unresolvable path. When the script IS present the guard runs exactly as before.
